Flags and Cases

▲ Spike

This week's denied lines for a slice (payer, provider, CPT, location, category, reason code, or a pair of these) are at least 2.5× what its own last 8 weeks predict, with at least 6 lines and less than a 1-in-1,000 chance of being noise.

↗ Rising

The last 4 weeks together run at least 2.5× the 8 weeks before them, and at least 3 of those 4 weeks were elevated. This catches slow build-ups that never look dramatic in a single week.

◆ Outlier

A payer or provider denies for a specific reason at 4× or more the rate seen everywhere else that week. This works from the first week of data, before any history exists.

How the numbers are counted

One posted line counts once, even with several denial codes. Duplicate IGNORE/WRITE_OFF rows are merged. Primary and secondary claims are tracked separately. Flags under $500 are hidden. Severity (red high, amber watch) is separate from flag type.
